user.title: Task as Quest - Login
user.description: Connect Home Assistant to your Task as Quest account. Format: Name#0001 (four-digit number).

totp.title: Two-Factor Authentication (2FA)
totp.description: If you have 2FA enabled in the app, enter the current code here. Otherwise, leave the field empty and click submit.

recovery.title: Encrypted Quests
recovery.description: Your account uses End-to-End Encryption. Please enter your encryption code.

error.auth_failed: Authentication failed. Check login name, password, and 2FA code if enabled.
error.recovery_code_required: This account uses encrypted quests. Enter the encryption code.
error.recovery_code_invalid: The encryption code is invalid or does not belong to this account.

add_rule.title: Add automation rule (Step 1)
add_rule.description: First, select the entity you want to monitor.

add_rule_details.title: Add automation rule (Step 2)
add_rule_details.description: When the entity matches the condition, a quest is created.

manage_rules.title: Manage rules
manage_rules.description: Choose a rule from the list to edit or delete it.

edit_rule.title: Edit rule
edit_rule.description: Change the rule parameters or delete it.
